blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The national government has allocated around ₱17 billion for infrastructure projects in Cebu, including five proposed water impounding structures worth approximately ₱1.1 billion, as part of efforts to implement the province’s long-delayed flood mitigation master plan.
